form:FormGroup.label: Namespace URI
form:FormGroup.helpText: XML namespace that this schema defines, e.g. event-logging:3. Schema validation uses it to find the right schema for the data.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Namespace the schema defines, e.g. event-logging:3.

form:FormGroup.label: System Id
form:FormGroup.helpText: Identifier that XML data uses in xsi:schemaLocation to refer to this schema, e.g. file://event-logging-v3.0.0.xsd.

form:FormGroup.label: Schema Group
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of a group of related schemas. A schema filter can be set to only use schemas in a given group.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Lets a schema filter use only schemas in this group.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether the schema is out of date. Data that names a deprecated schema is still validated against it, but each use gives a warning, so it can be moved to a newer schema.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Still used, but gives a warning.
